scientific_integrity: Mathematical proof and bounded independent enumeration supplied. Classical Munn-tree and Green-class minimum-length facts are attributed. No external independent audit or verification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: For the standard symmetric generators of finite-rank free inverse monoids only. This counts words of minimum element-length, not elements. Finite verification through length eight in rank two is not a proof for all ranks or lengths; the written proof uses the Munn tree representation. Absolute priority against unindexed or inaccessible historical literature is not established.
title: Factorial geodesic multiplicities and algebraic word growth in free inverse monoids
